stdout:
Usage: skilllint docs section [OPTIONS] {file_path} {heading}

  Print the text of a named section from a cached markdown file.
  
  Output is written to stdout.
  
  Exit status:
      1 when the heading is not found.

Arguments:
  file_path  Path to the cached markdown file.  [required]
  heading    Heading text to locate (case-insensitive, leading # optional).  [required]

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
